construct: Pathogenic IgG antibodies against the NR1 subunit of the NMDA receptor cause receptor internalization and reduced NMDA-receptor-mediated synaptic signaling; young women commonly develop prominent psychiatric symptoms followed by seizures, movement disorders, and autonomic instability, with an association with ovarian teratoma.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Rapid psychiatric change followed by seizures, orofacial dyskinesias, fluctuating consciousness, autonomic instability, inflammatory CSF, and ovarian teratoma identifies anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: HSV encephalitis can mimic acute encephalitis, but the psychiatric-to-seizure-to-dyskinesia/autonomic sequence plus ovarian teratoma is substantially more specific for anti-NMDAR encephalitis. LGI1 is age/phenotype mismatched; schizophrenia and NMS fail to explain the neurologic/inflammatory syndrome.
